effective_date_basis: The completion date of the work or contract, or a stated date; or the end of the suspension authority if shown to be war-contingent; otherwise a stated gap.
ending_pattern: The order suspends the eight-hour law for named work or contracts under a national-emergency suspension proviso (for the exemplar, the naval appropriation act of March 4, 1917). It ends when that work is completed, on a date in the order, or when the suspension authority itself ends. Whether the 1921 joint resolution (X1-E1) reaches a given authority must be shown: it reaches only provisions contingent on the war or the existing emergency.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Work already performed is an accrued effect.

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The suspension is general, for all contracts of an agency without limit.
Peacetime suspensions (public works, Panama Canal, 1930s emergency orders) that the 1921 resolution cannot reach.
The work or contract was never completed, or was modified or extended.
quoted_clause: I do hereby suspend the provisions of law prohibiting more than eight hours of labor in any one day by persons engaged in the construction of the Post Office Department equipment shops building, at Fifth and W Streets, NE., Washington, D. C. This order shall take effect from and after this date.

required_evidence: The order's text with the work or contracts covered.
The suspension authority (statute and section) and whether its terms depend on the war or emergency.

scope.note: Membership is a machine lead; each order is decided by an agent, row by row.

source.custody_limit: Exemplar text is a held copy graded mirror_transcription; it illustrates the type's wording and is not an authenticated original.
